name.zh-CN: 调阅血和穿刺液培养/药敏

zh-CN: 调阅血和穿刺液培养/药敏

text.zh-CN: 第4住院日前后双份穿刺液及血培养均检出紫色色杆菌（Chromobacterium violaceum）。报告美罗培南、亚胺培南、环丙沙星等敏感；头孢曲松、头孢他啶、哌拉西林耐药。判读标准和MIC未列出。
text.en: Around hospital day 4, two aspirate samples and blood grew Chromobacterium violaceum. Meropenem, imipenem and ciprofloxacin were among agents reported susceptible; ceftriaxone, ceftazidime and piperacillin were resistant. MICs and interpretive criteria are not supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

name.zh-CN: 调阅血常规及炎症指标
name.en: Review blood counts and inflammatory markers

zh-CN: 调阅血常规及炎症指标
en: Review blood counts and inflammatory markers

text.zh-CN: 入院白细胞29.26×10⁹/L、血红蛋白119 g/L、血小板205×10⁹/L；CRP 151.96 mg/L、PCT>25 ng/mL。恶化时血红蛋白57 g/L、血小板9×10⁹/L。
text.en: At admission WBC was 29.26×10⁹/L, haemoglobin 119 g/L and platelets 205×10⁹/L, with CRP 151.96 mg/L and PCT >25 ng/mL. During deterioration haemoglobin fell to 57 g/L and platelets to 9×10⁹/L.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 恶化时INR 1.77、PT 20.7秒、APTT 47.1秒，ALT 281 U/L、AST 990 U/L，乳酸887 mg/L（按原文单位保留）。
text.en: During deterioration INR was 1.77, PT 20.7 s, APTT 47.1 s, ALT 281 U/L, AST 990 U/L and lactate 887 mg/L (unit retained as reported).

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 第3住院日切开引流出约10 mL黄色脓液；组织大部坏死，急慢性炎细胞浸润及小脓肿。初始万古霉素治疗下仍进展。
text.en: On hospital day 3 incision and drainage yielded about 10 mL yellow pus. Tissue showed extensive necrosis, acute/chronic inflammation and microabscesses; illness progressed during initial vancomycin treatment.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 报告改用美罗培南并进行机械通气、休克和凝血支持、血液净化等。期间反复休克、出血及少尿；第7住院日休克和出血好转，血小板35×10⁹/L。第8日后进一步治疗终止，随访获悉死亡；短期指标改善不等于最终存活。
text.en: The report changed to meropenem and used ventilation, shock/coagulation support and blood purification. Recurrent shock, bleeding and oliguria occurred. Shock and bleeding improved by hospital day 7 and platelets reached 35×10⁹/L. Further treatment ended after day 8 and follow-up reported death; short-term improvement was not survival.

text.zh-CN: 紫色色杆菌侵袭性感染，伴脓毒性休克及器官功能损伤
text.en: Invasive Chromobacterium violaceum infection with septic shock and organ dysfunction

feedback.zh-CN: 血和病灶培养一致，伴灌注、意识及凝血异常，不能局限于皮肤诊断。
feedback.en: Concordant blood and lesion cultures with perfusion, neurological and coagulation abnormalities establish a systemic problem.

text.zh-CN: 只是局部脓肿，培养与全身症状无关
text.en: A local abscess only; cultures are unrelated to systemic illness

feedback.zh-CN: 血和病灶培养一致，伴灌注、意识及凝血异常，不能局限于皮肤诊断。

prompt.zh-CN: 进一步处理怎样避免延续无效方案？
prompt.en: How should further care avoid persisting with ineffective therapy?

text.zh-CN: PICU、感染和外科协作，紧急处理休克与感染灶，并按培养及可靠药敏调整抗菌方案
text.en: PICU, infection and surgery coordinate urgent shock care and source control, with antimicrobial revision using cultures and reliable susceptibility interpretation

feedback.zh-CN: 引流不代替有效抗菌和器官支持；具体药物和剂量需要专家评估，不能把病例药敏推广到所有菌株。
feedback.en: Drainage does not replace effective antimicrobials and organ support; expert selection is required and this isolate’s susceptibility cannot be generalised.

text.zh-CN: 因为已切开引流，只继续单用原抗革兰阳性菌方案等待
text.en: Continue only the original Gram-positive regimen because drainage has already been performed

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 病原与感染灶证据一致，最终结局为死亡；游泳是暴露线索而非已证实感染途径。
conclusion.en: Pathogen and source evidence are concordant and the final outcome was death; swimming is an exposure clue, not a proven route of infection.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 局部病灶恶化和全身灌注变化需要持续重新评估。
keyReasoning.en: Local progression and systemic perfusion changes require repeated reassessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 免疫功能部分筛查未见明显异常，不能排除所有先天免疫缺陷。
keyReasoning.en: Unremarkable selected immune tests do not exclude every inherited immune disorder.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
